readbased_minimap2.ref_db: biodb-fetch:mitohelper --doi-id 17602902 (MitoHelper/MitoFish 12S Zenodo reference; MMI + tax_lookup built locally per reference-db/run)

readbased_idtaxa.ref_db: NO stock IdTaxa model exists for 12S (SILVA SSU does not cover 12S) — opt-in only, after training a custom model from the fetched MitoFish FASTA; chain to nf-edna/idtaxa-training. Default classifier is readbased_minimap2.

consensus.classifier_note: 12S consensus classifies via minimap2-LCA against MitoFish (no SILVA-model shortcut); species-level calls are the default target rank, which is why this marker is usually the consensus-method workhorse
